About 400 candidates were issued offer letters at a job fair organised in Lalgudi in the district on Saturday.
The mega job fair, which was held at the behest of Lalgudi AIADMK MLA Leema Rose Martin to find private placement for unemployed youth of the constituency, drew about 2,000 participants.
Leading companies, including Rane, MRF, ITC, MM Forgings, Shriram Finance, Muthoot Finance, Sai Vidyalaya School, Ashwin Sweets and Kauvery Hospital, participated in the job fair inaugurated by Ms. Martin, according to a communication from the organisers, ONA Schools Private Limited and Martin Foundation.
